content:
I can’t determine the most likely next items from a single purchased item ID alone. That requires transaction or co-purchase data for item 95.

If you provide the grocery purchase dataset or a mapping of item IDs to co-purchase counts, I can return the top 10 item IDs in order.
prompt:
You are assisting a grocery retail analyst. Items are identified by numeric IDs.
A customer has bought item 95. Which 10 items are they most likely to buy next, in order of likelihood?
Answer with 10 integer item IDs, most likely first, separated by commas or one per line. No explanation.
